title: Round 7
notes: Round 7 (build 150), in progress: truly modal menus, BrailleNote braille roles, Sense, Pitch cues on Speech, Feditext-style settings, live profile counts, no Home feed tab, Expand/Collapse thread, Feditext More button, Help as a real menu, short menu hints, Liked Media filters, Back sounds, Unredream/Unquote Dream, Memeprojects spelled right, the Cherry page and Intelligence, Credits in my own words, Create Circle that saves your Circles, the old Dream Board names gone under the hood, and no more description on every menu item, and plain rows instead of description lists, and Dreamor options as a real pop-up menu, and a Create Circle that reads properly, and real hints only where they help, and publish and Dream wording everywhere, and the terminology guide restored with the post rule, and a cleaner repository with docs and app folders, and 2three1y as the only name in the app and docs, and a Credits page that reads like a real credits roll, and More items that are plain buttons, not headings, and the site footer with a new Child Safety page, and Edit profile opening again, and Commandbar in More, and no Ask Cherry on Discover, and full numbers everywhere, and Save that waits for a real change, and Markdown bios and Circle descriptions, and More with only Looscid features, and real page addresses and a page for every More item, and NexOS inside Looscid is Looscid OS now, and link previews with the Looscid logo, and Cherry saying what she did, and menus that say only their name, and For You, Following and Federated feed tabs with pinned tabs, and the footer as the very last thing, after the tab bar, and icons that VoiceOver no longer mistakes for unlabeled images, and Spring-style Settings with Sense pinned, values on every row and a Tab Bar page, and Subscribe to thread, and profiles with a Replies tab that shows only replies, and each reply on the Replies tab says what it answers, and an Inbox with NIP-17 private messages, and Who can message me that really applies to private messages, and a Home header that no longer covers the first Dream on small screens, and Profile tabs in your own order.
